title: Fix infinite recursion in deep copy
description: Custom clone method for a linked node object that handles circular references.
code:
def clone_node(node, memo=None):
    # Replicating a node with circular references
    new_node = Node(node.value)
    new_node.next = clone_node(node.next)
    return new_node
issue_description: Without tracking already copied nodes in a memoization dictionary, circular references cause a RecursionError.
issue_suggestion: Pass and update a memo dictionary to track and reuse already copied nodes.

title: Avoid blocking event loop with HTTP requests
description: Asynchronous task that fetches user data from a remote endpoint.
code:
import asyncio
import requests

async def get_user_data(user_id):
    url = f'https://api.site.com/users/{user_id}'
    response = requests.get(url)
    return response.json()
issue_description: Using requests.get synchronously halts the event loop, preventing all other concurrent coroutines from progressing.
issue_suggestion: Offload requests.get to a thread pool using asyncio.to_thread, or use an async client library like httpx.

title: Fix shared state in custom attribute descriptor
description: A validator class descriptor meant to restrict positive numbers.
issue_title: Attribute value shared across all class instances
issue_description: Storing the attribute value on the descriptor instance ('self.val') shares the value across all instances of the containing class.
issue_suggestion: Store the value directly in the owner instance dictionary or use a private attribute name key.

title: Fix infinite recursion in __getattribute__
description: Wraps a dictionary to expose keys as attributes.
issue_description: Accessing self.data inside __getattribute__ calls __getattribute__ again recursively, raising a RecursionError.
issue_suggestion: Retrieve 'data' using the base class object.__getattribute__ implementation to bypass custom lookup.

title: Prevent code execution via eval
description: Evaluates simple math expressions from user input.
issue_description: eval accepts arbitrary strings, allowing attackers to access builtins and execute system commands even with an empty globals dict.
issue_suggestion: Use ast.literal_eval for safe literal evaluation, or restrict allowed characters strictly.

title: Avoid modifying list during iteration
description: Removes even numbers from a list of values.
issue_title: Skipped elements when modifying list during loop
issue_description: Modifying a list in-place while iterating over it shifts the indexes, causing elements immediately following the removed ones to be skipped.
issue_suggestion: Iterate over a copy of the list or construct a new list using comprehension.
issue_code: return [num for num in numbers if num % 2 != 0]

title: Fix infinite loop with float comparison
description: Loops from 0.0 to 1.0 with small steps.
issue_title: Infinite loop due to float precision limits
issue_description: Floating-point addition causes precision drift (e.g. 0.1 added 10 times is 0.9999999999999999), meaning x will never exactly equal 1.0.
issue_suggestion: Use range with integer loops, inequality bounds (e.g. x < 1.0), or the math.isclose helper.

title: Fix late binding in closures
description: Creates a list of multiplier functions in a loop.
issue_description: The lambda function references the variable i, which resolves to its final value (4) when called, making all multipliers multiply by 4.
issue_suggestion: Bind the loop variable immediately using a default argument value.

title: Fix custom dict methods bypass
description: A custom dict subclass that logs writes.
issue_description: Directly subclassing builtin dict means operations like dict.update() or initialization bypass the overridden __setitem__, failing to log actions.
issue_suggestion: Subclass collections.UserDict instead of raw dict for consistent method overrides.
issue_code:
from collections import UserDict
class LoggingDict(UserDict):

title: Fix shared state in class constructor default
description: Initializes a registry manager class.
issue_description: Using a list as a default argument shares the same list instance across all RequestHandler objects initialized without arguments.
issue_suggestion: Use None as the default value and create a new list within the constructor body.
issue_code:
def __init__(self, data_list=None):
    self.data = [] if data_list is None else data_list

title: Fix thread local state leak
description: Stores transaction contextual information in thread-local storage.
code:
import threading

ctx = threading.local()

def process_request(user_id):
    # Bind user_id context to current thread
    ctx.user_id = user_id
    run_business_logic()
issue_title: Thread-local data persists across pooled threads
issue_description: In a thread pool environment, threads are reused. Forgetting to clean up ctx.user_id leaks context from one user request to another.
issue_suggestion: Use a try/finally block to clear the thread-local context once the request completes.
issue_code:
try:
    ctx.user_id = user_id
    run_business_logic()
finally:
    del ctx.user_id

title: Fix __slots__ subclass efficiency
description: Defines an efficient child class with slots.
issue_title: Subclass inherits slots but defines dynamic __dict__
issue_description: ChildNode inherits __slots__ but does not define __slots__ on itself, causing Python to automatically create a __dict__ for child instances, defeating memory savings.
issue_suggestion: Define __slots__ on the subclass to restrict instance variables to the base and subclass attributes.

title: Fix bad __hash__ compatibility
description: A custom user identifier class used in sets.
issue_description: If self.val is modified later, the hash changes, meaning the object can get lost in dict/set hash tables.
issue_suggestion: Ensure the attributes contributing to __hash__ are immutable or make the class frozen/read-only.

title: Prevent CPU burn in asyncio loop
description: A background task that checks status in a loop.
issue_title: Busy sleep loop consumes high CPU
issue_description: await asyncio.sleep(0) yields execution to other tasks but immediately reschedules, spinning the loop and burning CPU cycles if no other work exists.
issue_suggestion: Use a non-zero sleep interval (e.g. asyncio.sleep(0.1)) or use an asyncio.Event for signaling.

title: Fix weakref premature collection
description: Registers a callback on an object using weak references.
code:
import weakref

def register_cleanup_callback(target, callback):
    # Register callback using weakref mapping
    ref = weakref.ref(target, lambda r: callback())
    return ref
issue_title: Discarded weakref reference triggers cleanup immediately
issue_description: If the returned ref is not stored or kept alive by the caller, the weakref object itself is collected, potentially executing the callback prematurely.
issue_suggestion: Ensure the caller keeps the weakref object alive or bind it to the target's lifecycle.

title: Avoid relative path insertions in sys.path
description: Adds local paths to sys.path dynamically.
code:
import sys
import os

def load_plugins(plugin_dir):
    sys.path.insert(0, plugin_dir)
    import plugin_module
issue_description: Inserting raw strings into sys.path[0] allows local modules or malicious files in plugin_dir to override standard library modules during imports.
issue_suggestion: Ensure the directory path is absolute and verified, or use importlib.import_module with custom module loaders.

title: Prevent arbitrary code execution via PyYAML
description: Parses a configuration file uploaded by a user.
issue_title: Unsafe YAML loading allows arbitrary object instantiation
issue_description: yaml.load on untrusted input allows arbitrary Python object execution using yaml tags like !!python/object/apply.
issue_suggestion: Use yaml.safe_load to only parse standard YAML data types.

title: Fix race in double-checked locking
description: Creates a thread-safe singleton instance.
issue_description: The check outside the lock is not atomic. If two threads check concurrently before the singleton is created, both will attempt to acquire the lock and instantiate, or one can read a partially constructed object.
issue_suggestion: Perform the check both outside and inside the lock block (classic double-checked locking).

title: Avoid reference resurrection in __del__
description: Attempts to backup an object before it is garbage collected.
issue_description: Resurrecting an object inside __del__ prevents it from being collected, causing memory leaks and undefined behavior on subsequent collection attempts.
issue_suggestion: Avoid __del__ destructors completely; use weak references or context managers for resource lifetime tracking.
issue_code:
def close(self):
    # Use context manager instead

title: Avoid quadratic string concatenation in loops
description: Builds a text report from a stream of lines.
issue_title: Quadratic complexity of string concatenation in loop
issue_description: Strings are immutable. Using += inside a loop creates a new string object on every iteration, leading to O(N^2) complexity.
issue_suggestion: Collect elements in a list and join them using join() at the end.
